parent_objective: run preflight-only validation for M1485 calibrated neighbor-viability candidates
blocked_by: M1485 calibrated neighbor-viability candidates have not yet passed geometry preflight

public_gates: M1487 must run preflight-only with --candidate-step-column source_step
M1487 must not run replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1487 must report geometry rows selected rows clipping diversity source_group viability_class and duplicate neighbor viability keys
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat preflight result as replay evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs preflight-only geometry validation on M1485 calibrated neighbor-viability candidates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight smoke only; no replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if selected candidates collapse to one seed or capability pair
stop if candidate_step_column is not source_step
stop if replay training PPO promotion or corpus export starts
stop after M1487 for branch synthesis before any replay design
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if preflight passes
route to preflight result audit if geometry or diversity fails
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1486 admits neighbor viability preflight smoke

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up branch synthesis or preflight audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: geometry diversity and duplicate-key counts are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1487 is preflight-only and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future replay must test calibrated neighbor-source rows under normal history, warmup interventions, reset hidden, and zero-current controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1485 proposal smoke and M1486 preflight design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight fails, audit geometry/calibration pressure before replay or corpus export.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1485 calibrated neighbor-viability candidates will pass geometry preflight without clipping or diversity collapse.
failure_criteria: run starts replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change

commands.name: neighbor_viability_preflight_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.bounded_relocation_replay_probe --preflight-only --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m1419_warmup_gate_invasiveness_retune_source_wave.json --candidate-rows runs/m1485_neighbor_viability_calibration_proposal_smoke/neighbor_viability_candidate_rows.csv --max-candidate-rows 112 --per-capability-pair-cap 24 --per-seed-cap 24 --per-reveal-bucket-cap 24 --per-variant-cap 64 --history-length 56 --min-sequence-action-l2 0.025 --min-source-body-x 4.0 --candidate-step-column source_step --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1487_neighbor_viability_preflight_smoke

decision_rule: M1487 passes if M1485 calibrated candidates pass preflight without replay or training.
